title: A task branch of an item whose slug starts with queue- is…
what: lib/relay_tidy.py:54: MEDIUM: F2 a task branch of an item whose slug starts with queue- is named wt/queue-..., which relay reads as a leftover queue-landing branch
why: A task branch for an item whose slug starts with queue- is named wt/queue-..., which relay reads as a leftover queue-landing branch and may treat wrongly.
failing_case: Live queue has 9 open-or-closed items whose slug starts with "queue-" (e.g. queue-items-point-at-session-files-that-vanish).
relay_queue.leftover_branches lists it, so relay tidy/doctor reports "leftover queue branch: wt/queue-items-..." (a fixable leftover) while
the change is being built; relay_tidy.lines skips its worktree after merge; relay_inert absorbed() ignores it. Expected: a task branch is
never mistaken for a queue-landing branch.
pass_cases: 1. Start item "queue-items-point-at-session-files-that-vanish": relay doctor/tidy do not list its branch as a leftover queue branch.
2. A real leftover landing branch wt/queue-<slug> (left by a failed `relay queue` landing) is still listed.
3. After that task branch merges, tidy reports its worktree as "merged worktree still present" like any other task worktree.

fact: Reproduced by code read 30 Oct 2026 on master: task branches are "wt/" + the whole slug (lib/relay_lanes.py:569, _short at 479-480) and queue-landing branches are "wt/queue-" + slug (lib/relay_queue.py:866), so they collide by prefix. lib/relay_queue.py:758 lists refs/heads/wt/queue-* as leftovers (reported by lib/relay_tidy.py:54-55); lib/relay_tidy.py:39 and lib/relay_inert.py:228 skip any wt/queue- branch. 9 queue files have a slug starting with queue-. Not seen live yet.
